own_work.text: On weekdays I drive the delivery van for a furniture company around Shah Alam and the Klang Valley, loading and unloading sofas and tables, collecting signatures from customers, phoning them when I cannot find the house and filling up the diesel at the end of the shift, and on Saturdays I configure the wifi routers and fix the network problems for three small offices near my house

At the cafe where I work I take orders at the counter, make the drinks, clear the tables, sweep the floor before closing, restock the fridge with milk and sometimes deal with suppliers who come late with the bread, and after closing I reconcile the day's sales in the cash register against the card terminal records and keep the financial records for the owner in a spreadsheet

My job is in a call centre for a telco where I answer customers who complain about their bills, explain the packages, log every call in the system, escalate the angry ones to my supervisor and hit my targets for the month, and since last year the team leader also asks me to install software on the new laptops, set up user accounts and back up the shared drive every Friday

I work as a cashier in a hypermarket in Penang scanning groceries, handling cash and cards, bagging items, checking prices when the tag is wrong and helping old customers carry their things to the car park, but what I enjoy most is the small online shop I run on the side where I design the website, update the product pages every week and analyse the website visitor data to see which products people look at

In the warehouse I pick and pack online orders, label the boxes, drive the forklift to move pallets, count stock at the end of each month and maintain the inventory records in the stock system, and for my aunt's tuition centre I prepare the monthly budget, gather the financial records and prepare the financial reports she sends to her partners

I am a security guard at a condominium in Cyberjaya and my shift covers patrolling the floors, checking visitors in at the guard house, watching the CCTV screens, writing the incident book and opening the gate for residents, and during the quiet night hours I develop small software applications in Python and test the software performance before I send the code to my freelance clients

Most days I am a Grab driver picking up passengers from the airport and the malls, keeping the car clean, checking the tyres and planning the fastest routes around the traffic jams in Kuala Lumpur, and in between rides I calculate the tax information and prepare the financial documents for my father's hardware shop so that his accountant can file the returns

At the printing shop I run the photocopy machines, cut and bind documents, take payment from students, refill the paper and toner, and when the machines break I call the technician, and the owner also trusts me to maintain the computer hardware, install new printers and computers and resolve the computer software problems on the shop's four computers

I work in a bank branch as a teller counting cash, processing deposits and withdrawals, checking identity cards and balancing my drawer at the end of the day, and the branch manager also gives me the loan files to verify customer credit information, obtain financial information from applicants and examine their financial records before the loan officer decides

In the restaurant kitchen I wash the vegetables, prepare the sambal, cook the rice in big pots, plate the food during the lunch rush, clean the grill and take out the rubbish at night, and on my days off I help a small clinic by updating their patient database, entering information into their booking software and creating databases to store their records

As a sales assistant in a phone shop I explain the phone plans to customers, unbox and set up their new phones, transfer their photos and contacts, sell them screen protectors and cases and close the shop at ten, and for the shop owner I also analyse the market and customer data from our sales system and implement security measures for the shop's computer systems

I configure the computer networks and monitor the performance of the networks for a small logistics company two evenings a week, which I started doing after my diploma in computer networking, while in the daytime I still work as a dispatch clerk taking calls from drivers, printing delivery orders, keeping the delivery log and sorting the parcels by area

controls.text: My cousin configures the computer networks and fixes the network problems for small offices around Petaling Jaya while I just carry the cables, hold the ladder, buy the coffee, wait in the car and drive us home after he finishes the job

I have never prepared financial reports or reconciled financial accounts in any of my jobs because I work as a cleaner at a shopping mall where I mop the floors, empty the bins, clean the toilets and refill the soap dispensers every two hours

After my shift as a lorry driver delivering cement to construction sites in Johor, which starts at six in the morning and often ends after eight at night with traffic, I would like to learn to design websites and develop software applications

My manager reconciles the sales records and prepares the monthly budget for the whole outlet on her laptop in the back office while I stack the shelves, help customers find items and check the expiry dates on the yoghurt and milk
